Independent Tiffin, OH company during the 2019 grant; Steele Solutions (Milwaukee, WI) acquired it in 2022. Bucket rests on JobsOhio's 152 jobs retained at the Tiffin site (Form 5500 shows 76 plan participants in 2019); no direct headcount found.

Lexington, KY real-estate LLC with a Revitalization Grant Phase II and no jobs retained; news search ties the name to the former Hara Arena site in Trotwood, whose owner Corey Heitz demolished it in 2020 (ARRL), but no fetched page confirms the link. Privately held healthcare recruiting firm founded 2008; LinkedIn lists HQ in San Francisco and 51-200 staff today, so the Cleveland site was likely a regional office. The 2018 bucket rests on 14 jobs retained and a 2019 Form 5500 count of 13; HQ state at grant time not confirmed.

JobsOhio release (May 2021): Candice and Larry Hess Jr. founded the Pomeroy cafe in 2018; $50,000 Small Business Grant, 4 jobs committed. No headcount given, but the size of the business puts it well under 100.

Valeo North America is the US arm of Paris-listed auto supplier Valeo, which Wikipedia puts at about 113,600 employees (2018); the US subsidiary alone had 4,099 Form 5500 participants in 2015. No 2016 figure fetched, but the group is far above 5,000.

Family-owned paper maker headquartered in Cohoes, NY (Wikipedia); no parent. Bucket rests on Form 5500 counts of 752 (2015) and 734 (2019) for this EIN, which include former employees; no direct headcount fetched. Ashtabula mill closed in 2024 when assets went to Fedrigoni.
McLane Ohio is a unit of McLane Company (Temple, TX), a wholly owned Berkshire Hathaway subsidiary. Berkshire's FY2019 10-K reports about 391,500 employees; McLane alone is about 20,000 (Wikipedia).

Privately held steel-mill services and materials company headquartered in Dearborn, MI, started in 1918; its website says the team is over 2,500 people. The Delta, OH operation (40 jobs retained) serves the local steel mill.

NP FTC LLC is NorthPoint's project entity for the Fairfield Trade Center (Butler County), which a Business Journals headline (Mar 2024) ties to a JobsOhio/REDI grant. NorthPoint is privately held in Kansas City; LinkedIn lists 201-500 staff, so the bucket could sit near the 500 line.
